description: This file defines internal static class ApplicationRequestInstruments for metrics instrumentation related to application requests, including counters for timed out and canceled requests, and histograms for request latency.

classes.name: ApplicationRequestInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing metrics instruments for application request tracking, including counters and histograms.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsEnd
methods.description: Records the duration of an application request when it ends, updating the latency histogram aggregator.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsTimedOut
methods.description: Increments the counter for timed out requests.

methods.name: OnAppRequestsCanceled
methods.description: Increments the counter for canceled requests.
